panel.title: GDPR Work Folder Access - Process x Hour Heatmap

search.query: index=wineventlog EventCode=4663 (ObjectName="*Desktop\\Work*" OR ObjectName="*OneDrive\\Desktop\\Work*") earliest=$timerange.earliest$ latest=$timerange.latest$ | eval hour=strftime(_time, "%H:00") | eval process=coalesce(ProcessName, "unknown") | eval process_short=replace(process, "C:\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\([^\\\\]+)$", "\1") | stats count by process_short hour | sort hour

index=wineventlog EventCode=4663 (ObjectName="*Desktop\\Work*" OR ObjectName="*OneDrive\\Desktop\\Work*") earliest=$timerange.earliest$ latest=$timerange.latest$ | eval process=coalesce(ProcessName, "unknown") | eval authorized=case( match(process, "(?i)(explorer|OneDrive|SearchProtocolHost|Acrobat|Notepad|attrib|wsl)"), "YES", 1=1, "NO" ) | where authorized="NO" | stats count earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen values(ObjectName) as files_accessed by process SubjectUserName | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count | rename process as "Process" SubjectUserName as "User" count as "Events" first_seen as "First Seen" last_seen as "Last Seen" files_accessed as "Files Accessed"

panel.title: GDPR Alert - Customer Data Outside Work Folder

search.query: index=sysmon EventCode=11 earliest=$timerange.earliest$ latest=$timerange.latest$ (TargetFilename="*kunden*" OR TargetFilename="*client*" OR TargetFilename="*vertrag*" OR TargetFilename="*rechnung*" OR TargetFilename="*invoice*" OR TargetFilename="*contract*" OR TargetFilename="*DPIA*" OR TargetFilename="*ROPA*") NOT TargetFilename="*Desktop\\Work*" NOT TargetFilename="*OneDrive\\Desktop\\Work*" NOT TargetFilename="*splunk*" | eval process_short=replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "") | table _time process_short TargetFilename User | sort -_time | rename process_short as "Process" TargetFilename as "File Path" User as "User" _time as "Time"

panel.title: Event Volume - Hourly Trend with Baseline

search.query: index=sysmon earliest=-7d latest=now | timechart span=1h count as current_count | eventstats avg(current_count) as avg_count stdev(current_count) as stdev_count | eval upper_threshold=avg_count + (2 * stdev_count) | eval anomaly=if(current_count > upper_threshold, current_count, null()) | fields _time current_count avg_count upper_threshold anomaly

index=sysmon earliest=$timerange.earliest$ latest=$timerange.latest$ | eval EventLabel=case( EventCode=1, "1-ProcessCreate", EventCode=3, "3-NetworkConnect", EventCode=7, "7-ImageLoad", EventCode=10, "10-ProcessAccess", EventCode=11, "11-FileCreate", EventCode=13, "13-RegistryValue", EventCode=17, "17-PipeCreated", EventCode=22, "22-DNSQuery", EventCode=26, "26-FileDelete", 1=1, EventCode ) | timechart span=1h count by EventLabel

panel.title: Daily Event Volume - Sysmon vs WinEventLog

search.query: (index=sysmon OR index=wineventlog) earliest=-7d latest=now | eval source_index=if(index="sysmon","Sysmon","WinEventLog") | timechart span=1d count by source_index

index=sysmon EventCode=1 earliest=-24h latest=now (CommandLine="*sentinel*" OR CommandLine="*splunk*search*" OR Image="*curl*") (CommandLine="*8089*") | eval patrol="Sentinel Heartbeat" | table _time patrol | sort _time

| inputlookup sentinel_triage.csv where type="HEARTBEAT" earliest=-24h | stats count as heartbeats | eval expected=48 | eval coverage=round((heartbeats/expected)*100,1) | eval display=heartbeats." / ".expected." (".coverage."%)"

index=sysmon EventCode=1 earliest=-24h latest=now (CommandLine="*sentinel*heartbeat*" OR (CommandLine="*8089*" AND CommandLine="*search*")) | sort _time | streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_time | eval gap_minutes=round((_time - prev_time)/60, 1) | where gap_minutes > 45 | eval gap_start=strftime(prev_time, "%H:%M") | eval gap_end=strftime(_time, "%H:%M") | eval blind_spot=gap_start." -> ".gap_end." (".gap_minutes." min)" | table blind_spot gap_minutes | sort -gap_minutes | rename blind_spot as "Blind Spot" gap_minutes as "Duration (min)"

index=sysmon EventCode=1 earliest=$timerange.earliest$ latest=$timerange.latest$ | eval child=replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "") | eval parent=replace(ParentImage, ".*\\\\", "") | eval pair=parent." -> ".child | stats count earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen values(User) as users values(CommandLine) as cmds by pair parent child | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | where NOT ( match(pair, "(?i)svchost.*WmiPrvSE") OR match(pair, "(?i)svchost.*MicrosoftEdgeUpdate") OR match(pair, "(?i)svchost.*sdbinst") OR match(pair, "(?i)svchost.*rundll32") OR match(pair, "(?i)Code.*Code") OR match(pair, "(?i)Code.*code-tunnel") OR match(pair, "(?i)splunkd") OR match(pair, "(?i)Sysmon") ) | sort -count | head 30 | rename pair as "Parent -> Child" count as "Events" first_seen as "First Seen" last_seen as "Last Seen" users as "Users" cmds as "Command Lines"

panel.title: Credential Theft / C2 Indicators (CRITICAL - Always Alert)

search.query: index=sysmon EventCode=1 earliest=$timerange.earliest$ latest=$timerange.latest$ (CommandLine="*mimikatz*" OR CommandLine="*procdump*" OR CommandLine="*lazagne*" OR CommandLine="*secretsdump*" OR CommandLine="*rubeus*" OR CommandLine="*sharphound*" OR CommandLine="*bloodhound*" OR CommandLine="*nc -e*" OR CommandLine="*ncat -e*" OR CommandLine="*bash -i >*" OR CommandLine="*-NoP -NonI -W Hidden*" OR CommandLine="*IEX(*" OR CommandLine="*Invoke-Expression*" OR CommandLine="*Net.WebClient*" OR CommandLine="*certutil*urlcache*" OR CommandLine="*bitsadmin*/transfer*" OR CommandLine="*mshta http*" OR CommandLine="*regsvr32 /s /n /u*" OR Image="*mimikatz*" OR Image="*procdump*" OR Image="*lazagne*") | table _time Image ParentImage CommandLine User ProcessId | sort -_time | rename Image as "Process" ParentImage as "Parent" CommandLine as "Command Line" User as "User" ProcessId as "PID" _time as "Time"

index=sysmon EventCode=3 earliest=$timerange.earliest$ latest=$timerange.latest$ (DestinationPort=4444 OR DestinationPort=5555 OR DestinationPort=6666 OR DestinationPort=1337 OR DestinationPort=8888 OR DestinationPort=9001 OR DestinationPort=9999 OR DestinationPort=12345 OR DestinationPort=31337) NOT DestinationIp="127.0.0.1" | eval process_short=replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "") | table _time process_short DestinationIp DestinationPort User | sort -_time | rename process_short as "Process" DestinationIp as "Dest IP" DestinationPort as "Port" User as "User" _time as "Time"

index=sysmon EventCode=3 earliest=-7d latest=now NOT DestinationIp="127.0.0.1" NOT DestinationIp="10.*" NOT DestinationIp="172.16.*" NOT DestinationIp="192.168.*" NOT DestinationIp="fe80:*" NOT DestinationIp="ff02:*" NOT DestinationIp="0:*" | eval day=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d") | stats dc(DestinationIp) as unique_ips dc(DestinationPort) as unique_ports by day | sort day

index=sysmon EventCode=3 earliest=-7d latest=now NOT DestinationIp="127.0.0.1" NOT DestinationIp="10.*" NOT DestinationIp="172.16.*" NOT DestinationIp="192.168.*" NOT DestinationIp="fe80:*" NOT DestinationIp="ff02:*" NOT DestinationIp="0:*" | eval process_short=replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "") | stats earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen count values(process_short) as processes values(DestinationPort) as ports by DestinationIp | eval first_seen_day=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d") | eval today=strftime(now(), "%Y-%m-%d") | where first_seen_day=today | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count | rename DestinationIp as "Destination IP" processes as "Processes" ports as "Ports" count as "Connections" first_seen as "First Seen" last_seen as "Last Seen"

index=sysmon EventCode=3 earliest=$timerange.earliest$ latest=$timerange.latest$ NOT DestinationIp="127.0.0.1" NOT DestinationIp="10.*" NOT DestinationIp="172.16.*" NOT DestinationIp="192.168.*" NOT DestinationIp="fe80:*" NOT DestinationIp="ff02:*" NOT DestinationIp="0:*" | eval process_short=replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "") | stats count by process_short DestinationIp | sort -count | head 25

index=sysmon EventCode=22 earliest=$timerange.earliest$ latest=$timerange.latest$ | eval process_short=replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "") | stats count by QueryName process_short | sort -count | head 30 | rename QueryName as "Domain" process_short as "Process" count as "Queries"
index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 earliest=-7d latest=now | timechart span=1h count

index=wineventlog EventCode=4624 earliest=$timerange.earliest$ latest=$timerange.latest$ | eval LogonTypeLabel=case( LogonType=2, "2-Interactive", LogonType=3, "3-Network", LogonType=4, "4-Batch", LogonType=5, "5-Service", LogonType=7, "7-Unlock", LogonType=10, "10-RemoteInteractive", LogonType=11, "11-CachedInteractive", 1=1, LogonType ) | timechart span=1h count by LogonTypeLabel
